facts.text: I was standing in front of a full-length mirror in my room.
I was deciding between a black Chesterfield coat and a black down jacket to wear.
I planned to wear a white sweater underneath my black slim-fit slacks.
I planned to wear a snood and red socks with the outfit.
I had worn the Chesterfield-based outfit on multiple occasions during winter break.
I had seen Kikuchi-san twice over break so far.
I bought the black down jacket without any help from Hinami.
I had been looking at outfits posted by stylish people on a fashion app that Hinami told me about.
I stole the idea for the down jacket outfit from an outfit I liked on that app.
I believed the outfit I created might be my very first original outfit.
My little sister is a year younger than me.
My sister called me a weirdo and shut the door in my face.
My sister called me a weirdo again after the door banged open a second time.
I was on my way to meet Kikuchi-san at Omiya Station.
I was standing in front of the Bean Tree sculpture at Omiya Station at a few minutes to ten in the morning.
I awaited Kikuchi-san’s arrival at Omiya Station.
I greeted Kikuchi-san at Omiya Station with “Morning, Kikuchi-san.”
Kikuchi-san walked toward me from the station’s east exit wearing a green coat.
Kikuchi-san wore a fluffy sky-blue scarf that I believed was a blend of wool and angel feathers.
Kikuchi-san and I set off walking together very close to each other.
I said “Should we get going?” and Kikuchi-san said “Yes, let’s go.”
I started dating Kikuchi-san after a school festival where our class play was the catalyst.
I was Kikuchi-san’s first boyfriend.
Kikuchi-san was my first girlfriend.
We walked down the stairs outside the east exit and cut in front of the bronze statue of Toto-chan the squirrel.
A little boy was battering Toto-chan with his hand warmer like it was a beanbag.
Kikuchi-san waved at the little boy and then looked at me and said, “...He’s so cute.”
We were headed to Hikawa Shrine.
I chose Omiya Station as our meeting spot even though Hikawa Shrine was closer to Kita-Omiya Station.
We passed rows of beauty salons and vintage shops until we came to the end of Ichinomiya Road and took the crosswalk.
We passed under the shrine gate and entered the road leading to the main building at Hikawa Shrine.
My fingers brushed Kikuchi-san’s fingers and I withdrew my hand after her quiet gasp of surprise.

events.text: I decided what outfit to wear in front of the mirror in my room.
My little sister caught me posing and called me a weirdo, then shut the door.
My sister banged the door open again and called me a weirdo a second time.
I stood in front of the Bean Tree sculpture at Omiya Station at a few minutes to ten in the morning awaiting Kikuchi-san.

events.text: Kikuchi-san arrived from the station’s east exit wearing a green coat and we walked together toward Hikawa Shrine.
We walked through Omiya neighborhood and I withdrew my hand after my fingers brushed Kikuchi-san’s fingers.
